name: Caesar Salad
author: gucko on based.cooking
steps: Prepare a whole head of Romaine Lettuce by chopping off the root and rising thoroughly with water. Dry completely.
Once the lettuce is fully dry, put in a mixing bowl with lettuce and the Caesar Salad dressing. Toss to cover each leaf completely.

culture.text: A Caesar salad, also known as Caesar's salad, is a green salad of romaine lettuce and croutons commonly dressed with lemon juice, olive oil, eggs, Worcestershire sauce, anchovies, garlic, Dijon mustard, Parmesan and black pepper.
